feed.title: Free small-business calculators — tools on marisstella.dev
feed.subtitle: The 394 free, browser-only tools served directly from marisstella.dev — the newest 40 of them listed here, newest first. No account, no upload: every number stays on your own device. The full catalogue is larger and lives at tools.marisstella.dev.
feed.rights: Tools are MIT-licensed. They are estimates and records to act on, not professional advice.

entry.title: Backdoor Roth Pro-Rata Calculator — Form 8606, Free
entry.summary: Free calculator for the backdoor Roth pro-rata rule: how much of your Roth conversion is taxable given your after-tax basis and your December 31 traditional, SEP and SIMPLE IRA balance, plus the tax you could avoid by rolling pre-tax money into a 401(k). Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Estimated Tax Penalty Calculator — Form 2210 Underpayment, Free
entry.summary: Free estimated tax penalty calculator: see your IRS Form 2210 underpayment penalty installment by installment, check the 90% and prior-year safe harbors, and get a catch-up plan. Runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Home Office Deduction Calculator — Simplified vs Regular, Free
entry.summary: Free home office deduction calculator for the self-employed: compare the IRS simplified method ($5 per sq ft, max $1,500) with the regular Form 8829 method, including the gross income limit, depreciation and carryover. Runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Mileage Deduction Method Calculator — 2026, Free
entry.summary: Free calculator comparing the 2026 IRS standard mileage rate (72.5 cents per mile through June 30, 76 cents from July 1) with actual vehicle expenses for a self-employed business car. See which deduction is larger and what it is worth. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Self-Employment Tax Calculator 2026 — Schedule SE, Free
entry.summary: Free 2026 self-employment tax calculator for freelancers and sole proprietors: Social Security and Medicare, the $184,500 wage base, W-2 wages, Additional Medicare Tax, and how much of every payment to set aside. Runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: STR Tax Loophole Calculator — 2026, Free
entry.summary: Free calculator for short-term rental owners: does your Airbnb or VRBO escape rental-activity status (average stay of 7 days or less) and qualify as non-passive through material participation? Compare the $25,000 passive path and estimate first-year cost segregation depreciation with 100% bonus. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Solo 401(k) Contribution Calculator — 2026, Free
entry.summary: Free calculator for the 2026 Solo 401(k) contribution limit for a sole proprietor or single-member LLC — employee elective deferral (up to $24,500, or $32,500/$35,750 with catch-up), employer profit-sharing contribution (20% of net self-employment earnings), and the combined $72,000/$80,000/$83,250 overall limit. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: BOI Reporting Exemption Checker — 2026 FinCEN Rule, Free
entry.summary: Free checker for whether your company still owes a federal Corporate Transparency Act beneficial ownership report after FinCEN's August 2026 final rule permanently exempted every U.S.-formed entity. Applies to foreign-formed entities registered to do business in the U.S. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Bonus Depreciation vs. Section 179 Calculator — 2025-2026, Free
entry.summary: Free calculator comparing 100% bonus depreciation, a Section 179 election, and plain MACRS depreciation for a new equipment or asset purchase — with the 2025/2026 OBBBA dollar limits and phase-out, the net-operating-loss vs. carryforward distinction, and cash tax savings for each path. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Charitable Deduction Calculator — 2026 Non-Itemizer vs. Itemized, Free
entry.summary: Free calculator comparing two 2026 OBBBA charitable-giving paths: the new $1,000/$2,000 above-the-line deduction for non-itemizers vs. itemizing cash gifts after the new 0.5%-of-AGI floor. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Child Tax Credit Calculator — Free 2025/2026 CTC & ACTC Estimator
entry.summary: Free calculator for the federal Child Tax Credit and Credit for Other Dependents (One Big Beautiful Bill Act, permanent from 2025): $2,200 per qualifying child, $500 per other dependent, the $50-per-$1,000 MAGI phase-out above $200,000 single or $400,000 joint, the filer-SSN requirement, and the refundable Additional Child Tax Credit ceiling. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Claude Code Hooks Security Check — scan hook commands for dangerous shapes
entry.summary: Paste a Claude Code hooks configuration and see which command strings match known-dangerous shapes: a remote download piped straight into a shell, a credential file read and sent over the network, an unguarded recursive delete, TLS verification disabled, and more. Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: EITC Calculator — Free 2025/2026 Earned Income Tax Credit Estimator
entry.summary: Free calculator for the federal Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC): the phase-in, plateau, and phase-out by number of qualifying children and filing status, the investment income limit, the married-filing-separately living-apart exception, and the AGI-vs-earned-income rule most hand calculations skip. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Estate Tax Exemption Calculator — 2026 $15M OBBBA Exclusion, Free
entry.summary: Free calculator for the 2026 OBBBA federal estate, gift, and GST tax exclusion -- $15,000,000 per person, up to $30,000,000 married with portability. Projects taxable estate and the flat 40% federal tax. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Excess Business Loss Calculator — 2025-2026, Free
entry.summary: Free calculator for the IRC 461(l) excess business loss limitation, now permanent under OBBBA — computes how much of a pass-through owner's net business loss is deductible this year against the 2025/2026 threshold, and how much becomes a net operating loss carryforward. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Exempt Salary Threshold Checker — Federal + State, 2026, Free
entry.summary: Free calculator for the 2026 FLSA white-collar overtime-exemption salary threshold — checks a weekly salary against the federal $684/week figure and the higher state threshold in California, Washington, New York, Maine, or Alaska, including New York's professional-exemption carve-out. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Final Paycheck Deadline Calculator — By State, Free
entry.summary: Free calculator for the legal deadline on a departing employee's final paycheck — by US state and separation type (fired/laid off vs. quit), including California's notice-based rule, Minnesota's demand-triggered 24-hour rule, and whether the state requires accrued unused vacation/PTO to be paid out. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Freelance Writer Rate Calculator — Per-Word vs. Flat Fee, Free
entry.summary: Free calculator for freelance writers, copywriters, and ghostwriters comparing a per-word rate against a flat project fee for the same job -- computing the real effective hourly rate each pricing method pays once research and revision time are counted, and the price needed to hit an hourly income goal. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Gambling Loss Deduction Calculator — OBBBA 90% Cap, 2026, Free
entry.summary: Free calculator for the OBBBA gambling loss deduction limit: your allowable Schedule A deduction is the lesser of your actual losses or 90% of your winnings, starting with 2026 tax returns. See exactly how much of your winnings becomes taxable "phantom income" even if you broke even or lost overall. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: HSA Contribution Limit Calculator — 2026, Free
entry.summary: Free calculator for the 2026 HSA contribution limit — self-only $4,400 or family $8,750, the $1,000 age-55 catch-up, HDHP qualification bounds, monthly proration for partial-year eligibility, and the last-month rule's testing-period tradeoff. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: MRR Waterfall Calculator — Net & Gross Revenue Retention
entry.summary: Break starting MRR into new, expansion, reactivation, contraction, and churned MRR, then get ending MRR, gross and net revenue retention, and your growth-to-loss quick ratio. Runs entirely in your browser.

entry.title: Patreon Fee Calculator — Real Monthly Payout After Platform and Processing Fees
entry.summary: Free calculator for Patreon creators: find real monthly take-home after your plan's platform fee (10% Standard, or 5/8/12% on a legacy Lite/Pro/Premium page) and per-charge payment processing, see whether per-creation billing is quietly costing you more in fees than monthly billing, and check how many more patrons close a monthly income gap.

entry.title: PyPI Provenance Check — Which of Your Python Dependencies Lack Trusted Publishing?
entry.summary: Paste a requirements.txt, a PEP 621 pyproject.toml, or a plain package list and see which Python packages were published with a PyPI provenance attestation (trusted publishing / OIDC via GitHub Actions or another supported CI) and which still rely on a classic, stealable API token. Free, no account, two read-only requests per package to the public PyPI API.

entry.title: QSBS Exclusion Calculator — Section 1202, Free
entry.summary: Free calculator for the Section 1202 Qualified Small Business Stock (QSBS) gain exclusion, expanded by OBBBA — compares the old all-or-nothing 5-year rule against the new tiered 3/4/5-year schedule for stock acquired after July 4, 2025, and the higher $15M exclusion cap. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Referrer-Policy & Permissions-Policy Checker — unsafe-url, wildcard features, syntax
entry.summary: Free tool: run a CLI that sends one real request to your site, then paste the JSON here for a plain-English report on Referrer-Policy: unsafe-url (leaks full URLs, even on a downgrade), a missing or invalid Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy directives with a malformed allowlist syntax, and a wildcard allowlist on a sensitive feature like camera or microphone. Nothing uploaded.

entry.title: SALT Deduction Cap Calculator — 2025-2026, Free
entry.summary: Free calculator for the SALT (state and local tax) itemized deduction cap under the One Big Beautiful Bill Act — applies the 2025/2026 $40,000/$40,400 cap, the 30%-of-excess-MAGI phase-out above $500,000/$505,000, and the $10,000 floor the cap can never drop below, by filing status. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Section 174A Catch-Up Deduction Calculator — 1-Year vs. 2-Year, Free
entry.summary: Free calculator for the Section 174A domestic R&E catch-up deduction (OBBBA, Rev. Proc. 2025-28): compares taking your entire remaining unamortized 2022-2024 R&E balance in 2025 against spreading it over 2025-2026, with current-year cash tax savings, an NOL flag when a deduction exceeds taxable income, and a present-value comparison. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Auto Glass Bid Calculator — Windshield, ADAS Calibration, Mobile Fee
entry.summary: Price a windshield or door-glass replacement from glass source, ADAS camera/sensor calibration, mobile trip fee, and cash vs. insurance billing — and get warned before you send a bid that forgot to price the calibration.

entry.title: Auto Loan Interest Deduction Calculator — 2026 QPVLI Estimator, Free
entry.summary: Free calculator for the new federal auto loan interest deduction (One Big Beautiful Bill Act, tax years 2025-2028): applies the $10,000 cap, the $200-per-$1,000 MAGI phase-out, and the 8-item new/US-assembled/personal-use/first-lien eligibility checklist -- including the MFS treatment most people get wrong. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Backup File Exposure Checker — Is Your backup.zip or .sql Dump Public?
entry.summary: Free tool: paste your site's URL and it sends real GET requests to eight well-known backup filenames (backup.zip, backup.tar.gz, backup.sql, db.sql, and more), verifying the response against a real archive's magic bytes or a real SQL dump's line shape -- not just an HTTP status -- to name whether your deployment is publicly serving a full site or database backup. Never reads row data out of a matched SQL dump, never extracts a matched archive. Nothing uploaded to us.

entry.title: CAA Record Checker — Which CA Can Issue Your Certificate?
entry.summary: Free tool: paste a hostname and it resolves the CAA record set that actually governs certificate issuance -- walking up your DNS tree per RFC 8659 to the ancestor domain that publishes one, not just the exact name you typed -- flags malformed records and a critical unrecognized tag that silently blocks every CA, and names whether Let's Encrypt, Google Trust Services, DigiCert, and 5 more are authorized to issue. Nothing uploaded to us; only public DNS is read.

entry.title: Claude Code Settings Check — find hooks that never fire and permission rules that never match
entry.summary: Paste a Claude Code settings.json (and, optionally, settings.local.json) and get every structural mistake flagged: a hook matcher that can't compile, a hook with no command, a misspelled event name, a permission rule with unbalanced parentheses, a rule duplicated across allow/deny/ask, and a rule that contradicts itself across the two files. Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Claude Code Subagent Check — find subagents that never get delegated to
entry.summary: Paste a Claude Code subagent definition (.claude/agents/*.md) and get every structural mistake flagged: a name that isn't kebab-case, a missing or vague description that stops automatic delegation, a tools list with an empty or unrecognized entry, an unrecognized model alias, and a near-empty system prompt. Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Claude Skill Scaffold Generator — turn a plain-language description into a starter SKILL.md
entry.summary: Type what a Claude Agent Skill should do and when Claude should use it, plus any scripts, references, or assets it bundles, and get a starter SKILL.md with valid YAML frontmatter and a suggested folder layout -- checked for the common authoring mistakes that keep a skill from triggering. Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing uploaded, no model call.

entry.title: Cloud Bucket Exposure Checker — is your S3/GCS/Azure bucket publicly listable?
entry.summary: Free tool: run a CLI that sends one real, read-only request to an AWS S3 bucket, a Google Cloud Storage bucket, or an Azure Blob container you name, then paste the JSON here for a plain-English report on whether anyone on the internet can list its contents with no credentials. Never fetches an object's own content, only the listing. Nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Depop Fee Calculator — What You Actually Keep After Depop's Fee
entry.summary: Free Depop seller fee calculator for the US and UK schedule (0% selling fee, 3.3%+$0.45 or 2.9%+£0.30 processing on item price + shipping) and the rest-of-world flat 10% schedule, plus Boosted Listings. Real profit, price for a target profit, and a region-by-region comparison. Nothing leaves your browser.

entry.title: Economic Nexus Threshold Tracker — Which States Have You Crossed?
entry.summary: Free browser tracker for online and multi-channel sellers: enter trailing-12-month gross sales and transaction count by state, and see which states' economic-nexus sales-tax-registration thresholds you've crossed, per state, against each state's own published $100k/$250k/$500k and 200-transaction figures. Runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Employee vs. Contractor Cost Calculator
entry.summary: Free calculator comparing the fully-loaded cost of a W-2 employee against a 1099 contractor for the same role — FICA, capped FUTA/SUTA, workers' comp, PTO, benefits, payroll admin, and one-time onboarding, plus the contractor rate at which the two cost the same. Nothing leaves your browser.

entry.title: Facebook Marketplace Fee Calculator — What You Actually Keep on a Shipped Sale
entry.summary: Free Facebook Marketplace seller fee calculator: 10% of the buyer-paid total (item price + shipping + tax collected) on a shipped checkout order, $0.80 minimum fee, $0 for local pickup, plus the flat $20 dispute penalty if one applies. Real profit, price for a target profit. Nothing leaves your browser.

entry.title: Hidden Unicode Check — find invisible and bidi characters in a file
entry.summary: Paste CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cursorrules, copilot-instructions.md, a README, or any text and find zero-width characters, Unicode tag characters, and bidirectional (RLO/LRO) override characters hidden from human review -- the technique behind current AI-agent prompt-injection attacks and Trojan Source. Free, private, runs entirely in your browser.
